text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to the Municipality of Casiguran, Province of Sorsogon, for a period of
twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and
operate an electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light,
heat and power, for sale within the limits of its territory.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 8, 1932.
